scope: own fp32 ONNX decoder prefill+step graphs from the official checkpoint; logits/token parity; not fp16, not chunked-state encoder, not library integration

sanitizer.note: legacy Split num_outputs attributes dropped for opset>=13; pipeline parity gates re-verified afterwards

contract.prefill: seed: input_ids int64 [batch, 1] (BOS) + encoder_hidden_states f32 [batch, frames, 320] -> logits f32 [batch, 1, 32768] + 6x present_k/present_v [batch, 8, 1, 40]
contract.step: input_ids int64 [batch, 1] + encoder_hidden_states + 6x past_k/past_v [batch, 8, past>=1, 40] (positions from cache length) -> logits [batch, 1, 32768] + grown histories
contract.staticTokenDim: both graphs take exactly one token so `q_len > 1` stays a Python bool and SDPA is_causal never becomes symbolic; single-token attention over the full past is greedy causal semantics
contract.cross: cross-attention key/value are computed inside each graph from encoder_hidden_states; the graph set is stateless across utterances

parity.tolerance: atol 1e-4 on final-position logits per step

tokens.text: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.

limits: Prefill graph covers the empty-past case; the step graph requires past >= 1 by design.
Single fixture (JFK), CPU execution provider, greedy decoding only; no memory or speed claim.
